Report title: Census of Jails, 2005–2019 – Statistical Tables  NCJ 255406
Data source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Census of Jails, 2005, 2013, and 2019
Authors: Zhen Zeng, Ph.D., and Todd D. Minton, BJS Statisticians
Table 3. The 50 largest local jail jurisdictions, midyear 2019
Southwest Virginia Regional Jail Authority, VA/f

Note: Jail jurisdictions are listed in order of their confined inmate population at midyear 2019. Most jail jurisdictions consist of a single facility, but some have multiple facilities. If at least one facility reported data, the jail jurisdiction was counted as a responding jail jurisdiction and data were estimated for the nonresponding facilities in that jail jurisdiction. For 2013, data were estimated for the nonresponding facilities in New York City, NY, Allegany County, PA, Davidson County, TN, and Franklin County, OH. For 2019, data were estimated for the nonresponding facilities in Gwinnett County, GA, El Paso County, CO, and Milwaukee County, WI. Details may not sum to totals due to rounding.
:Not calculated because the numerator and denominator are not based on the same jail jurisdictions.
a/As of midyear (last weekday in June).

c/Data were adjusted for survey and item nonresponse and rounded to the nearest 10. See Methodology for nonresponse adjustment procedures. Imputed values were used to calculate aggregate statistics but are not displayed for individual jail jurisdictions.
d/Did not respond to the 2013 Census of Jails.
e/Did not respond to the 2019 Census of Jails.

f/The Southwest Virginia Regional Jail Authority serves the Virginia counties of Buchanan, Dickenson, Lee, Russell, Scott, Smyth, Tazewell, Washington, and Wise and the city of Norton. The jail jurisdiction was not included in the 2005 Census of Jails.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Census of Jails, 2005, 2013, and 2019.
